english: take the first street on the left
also: take the first street on the right
the first turning on the left

terms.gloss: take the first street on the left
terms.grammar: ad sinistram, ad dextram: on the left, on the right; viam ingredī, enter on a road
terms.comment: Our sentence. We have found no set phrase for this in the authors we searched or in Traupman, Morgan–Owens, or Levi–Bini. Its parts are classical: Plautus counts the streets from a landmark (hoc est sextum ā portā proxumum angiportum, Ps. 960), Terence gives ad sinistram and ītō ad dextram (Ad. 582–583), and Cicero has viam ingredī (Sen. 6). Terence’s Syrus, giving directions, names landmarks rather than numbers: ubi eās praeterieris, ad sinistram hāc rēctā platēā. A narrow street is angiportum; Traupman counts crossroads, ūsque ad secundum compitum (p. 173).

terms.latin: Ad prīmum compitum sinistrōrsum tē verte.
terms.gloss: turn left at the first crossroads
evidence: Traupman 173: dein tē verte dextrōrsum et prōcēde ūsque ad secundum compitum

phrases.latin: Habuī numerum sēdulō: hoc est sextum ā portā proxumum angiportum, in id angiportum mē dēvortī jusserat
phrases.english: I’ve kept careful count: this is the sixth street from the gate, and that’s the street he told me to turn into

phrases.latin: ubi eās praeterieris, ad sinistram hāc rēctā platēā; ubi ad Diānae vēneris, ītō ad dextram
phrases.english: when you have passed it, go left, straight along this street; when you come to Diana’s temple, turn right

phrases.latin: Abī istāc trāvorsīs angiportīs ad forum
phrases.english: Go that way, by the side streets, to the forum

phrases.latin: Prīmam viam ad dextram ingrediēmur, deinde rēctā ībimus.
phrases.english: We’ll take the first street on the right, and then go straight on.

phrases.latin: sed hinc concēdam in angiportum hoc proxumum, inde hīsce ostendam mē, ubi erunt ēgressī forās
phrases.english: but I’ll step aside from here into the next street, and show myself to them from there when they come out

phrases.latin: Domus aviae in secundā viā ad dextram est.
phrases.english: Grandma’s house is in the second street on the right.
